findings.title: Return null when the new unknown-input normalizer cannot inspect its argument
findings.description: normalizePersistenceFailure(error: unknown) reads instanceof, kind, transaction, code, errno, message, cause and String(value) without an inspection guard. Unreadable inputs throw instead of returning null. Both independently generated adapters reproduce eight distinct exceptions: code accessor, cause accessor, message accessor, nested cause accessor, get proxy, prototype proxy, revoked proxy and failing code conversion.
findings.impact: The native helper is a new exported API accepting unknown; callers cannot use its documented fail-closed normalization reliably. The new HTTP catch invokes it directly, so an inspection exception can interrupt fallback error handling (source inference, not an independently injected HTTP unreadable-driver result). No malicious native-host privilege or new security boundary is inferred.
findings.required_correction: Keep bounded/cyclic/unknown-COMMIT checks and exact native FK signatures, but contain all inspection/classification including initial instanceof in a try/catch that returns null when inspection fails. Add executable unreadable-input negatives. Review the fixed immutable correction; current365223a is not approved.
